brief: @buildthis.bisks.net : a simple and refined website with good structured html and css, but as the user scrolls down it gradually gets polluted with more ads, gimmicks, useless content, insane formatting and annoying pop-ups until the user is trapped in an unhinged unbearable mad Boschian hellscape.
note: a clean, well-typeset banana bread recipe that curdles into ad-clogged Boschian chaos the deeper you scroll — real recipe waits at the bottom for survivors.
